channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Derrick Rose | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Derrick Rose from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Derrick Rose, Jeff Teague, Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“The first team we play against is the Clippers, and if we win, the Minnesota gets into the playoffs after 16 years. Jimmy Butler has been there, Derrick Rose has been there, all these different players have been there, high-level players, all-star, Jeff Teague, all-star caliber type players, and Minnesota has never been there. Andthen you inject Pat Bev in there and we're playing with a number seven seed.”

Patrick Beverley on Derrick Rose, Jeff Teague, Jimmy Butler, Sep 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Horace Grant on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Grant said in an exclusive interview.

“What a beast. What a freakin’ beast. He has all the intangibles, the skillset. But what I love about him is that he has the mindset of a killer. A dog. He goes out and gets it. “It’s one of the best draft picks since Derrick Rose. I’m not going to put him with MJ and myself and Pip, but since Derrick Rose, one of the greatest choices the Bulls have made, in my humble opinion.”

Horace Grant on Derrick Rose, Aug 24, 2026. Source: Action Network.

item.title: John Poulakidas on Derrick Rose
item.description:
“I just think back to elementary school days when Derrick Rose was the king of Chicago,”

John Poulakidas on Derrick Rose, Apr 16, 2026. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Jeff Teague says Derrick Rose was harder to guard than Steph Curry:

“I could stay in front of Steph. He might step back and hit a shot. I couldn’t stay in front of Derrick Rose. There’s nothing you could do. You could back all the way up, he’d look at you, and run at you full speed and do a crossover and he’s at the rim”

Stephen Curry on Derrick Rose, Mar 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Derrick Rose, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Detroit Pistons head coachJB Bickerstaff on what stands out about Sixers rookie VJ Edgecombe:

“The speed, and just how dynamic he is… He reminds me of Derrick Rose when Derrick Rose was young.”

JB Bickerstaff on Derrick Rose, VJ Edgecombe, Nov 9, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Quentin Grimes on Derrick Rose
item.description:
“Derrick was a big influence on Jalen’s life. He would ask him a lot of questions and talk to him almost all the time during that second year when we were all in New York.”

Quentin Grimes on Derrick Rose, Jan 12, 2025. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Quentin Grimes on Derrick Rose, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“Probably Jalen Brunson. You know what I mean? Derrick grew up in Chicago, and Jalen’s dad coached him during high school,”

Quentin Grimes on Derrick Rose, Jalen Brunson, Jan 12, 2025. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah
item.description:
Anthony appeared on ESPN’s First Take in 2019 and revealed that he was close to joining Bulls in 2014 before deciding to return to New York.

“I was going to Chicago. Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah. I was there, right? I was there. And then I started getting whispers behind the scenes. ‘Yo, look, this person ain’t gonna be there. It ain’t really right. This and that.’ And it was all of that started to come up in the midst of my decision-making. I wasn’t going to let anything cloud that,”

Carmelo Anthony on Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, May 20, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Thibs on Derrick Rose:

“To have a guy like that around is invaluable. Even though he’s not playing, he’s had a great impact on all our guys.. Whatever role you ask him to play, he embraces it & wants to be great at it. He’s always cared about the team the most & winning.”

Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose, Apr 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Charles Barkley on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Derrick Rose
item.description:
“They did it a lot with LeBron, which makes me laugh, too. Derrick Rose won it. He deserved it. Kevin Durant won it. He deserved it. It’s a regular season award. It ain’t who the best player is. It’s who had the best regular season, but every year ESPN gets these fools on radio and TV to talk about who’s the best player…They have these silly things every year and it’s really just, that’s the silliness of these morning talk shows.”

Charles Barkley on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Derrick Rose, Mar 7, 2023. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Derrick Rose, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“I've been in the league with DRose [Derrick Rose] and Russell Westbrook, so many athletic guards I'm missing, but those two stick out the most to me. The stuff they were doing was unheard of, and you're seeing other guys doing the same thing. I'm sure he's inspired by those two as well. The league's in a great place.”

Kevin Durant on Derrick Rose, Russell Westbrook, Oct 24, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose:

“I don’t know if it was a surgery. It was something to clean up where they did the surgery.”

Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose, Feb 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose
item.description:
KC Johnson:Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose:

“It’s still breathtaking when he’s coming at you with a head of steam. I haven’t seen anyone stop him yet. It’s special. That’s his gift. But just understanding the game, it’s like a baseball pitcher adding another pitch. He has seen every defense.”

Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose, Oct 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Derrick Jones Jr on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Before he became a member of the Chicago Bulls, Derrick Jones Jr. was a fan.

“This has always been my favorite NBA team. I haven’t told anybody in the NBA that. I’ve always been a big D-Rose (Derrick Rose) fan and a big (Michael) Jordan fan,”

Derrick Jones Jr on Derrick Rose, Sep 30, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose
item.description:
#PistonsJerami Grant on difference after Griffin/Rose left:

“I think the young guys did a great job of stepping up and doing what they needed to do, on both ends.”

Jerami Grant on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose, Apr 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Eric Bledsoe on Derrick Rose
item.description:
“I wasn’t paying attention. Lack of focus. D-Rose got downhill and made a great play.”

Eric Bledsoe on Derrick Rose, Apr 18, 2021. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Mason Plumlee on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Mason Plumlee on the void left by Derrick Rose and Blake Griffin:

“As far as leadership, they were great, especially with the young guys.”

Mason Plumlee on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose, Mar 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Mason Plumlee on Derrick Rose
item.description:
James Edwards III:Mason Plumlee on change in leadership since Blake and Derrick left:

“We have guys who are willing to speak up, but those guys have been in big games, big moments, and that's what you miss.”

Mason Plumlee on Derrick Rose, Mar 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose's impact:

“He sees the game almost like an artist...the one thing you know about Derrick Rose is you're going to get his best, whether it's practice or a game.”

Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose, Feb 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Rivers said he and Thibodeau talked after the Rose trade and got the sobering news.

“They had told me after the game (on Feb. 7 vs. Miami) that they were bringing Derrick in,”

Austin Rivers on Derrick Rose, Feb 24, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Derrick Rose:

“Derrick is a pro's pro. Like Blake Griffin, he's going to be in the Hall of Fame someday.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose, Feb 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose, Dennis Smith
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Dennis Smith Jr.:

“He's a versatile guard and he can get to where he wants to -- he's a lot like Derrick (Rose)...there's a lot of things we can use him in in our offense.”

Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose, Dennis Smith, Feb 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Mike Vorkunov:Tom Thibodeau on newest Knicks PG Derrick Rose:

“Even when you back to the year he spent in NY he still averaged 18 points a game. He averaged 18 points a game in Minnesota. He averaged 18 points a game in Detroit. So he's always been able to contribute.”

Tom Thibodeau on Derrick Rose, Feb 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on the timing of making the Derrick Rose trade now, rather than at the deadline:

“You would have to ask Troy, but the opportunity was there to get a second round pick and prospective player for our team.”

Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose, Feb 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Derrick Rose, Delon Wright, Killian Hayes, Saben Lee
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Jerami Grant on Hayes/Rose injuries and relying on Delon Wright and Saben Lee:

“It's definitely tough, but they're ready; they put a lot of work in.”

Jerami Grant on Derrick Rose, Delon Wright, Killian Hayes, Saben Lee, Jan 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Luol Deng, Derrick Rose, Saddiq Bey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Saddiq:

“I see him as a Luol Deng-type, that's who Derrick told me he reminded me of.”

Dwane Casey on Luol Deng, Derrick Rose, Saddiq Bey, Jan 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on handling Blake Griffin and Derrick Rose in preseason:

“We're not in a position to rest; we've been off for nine months.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Derrick Rose, Dec 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose helping team chemistry:

“He's taking young guys like Killian and Saben under his wing ... that's priceless.”

Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose, Dec 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Killian Hayes on Derrick Rose
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Killian Hayes:

“I'm always asking questions and at the end of practice, we talk about things. I'm glad to have a guy like D Rose helping me.”

Killian Hayes on Derrick Rose, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose
item.description:
I asked Dwane Casey on Rose's management:

“I don't think anyone has changed from last year. It might be easier with guys in Hayes and Wright who are guards. Anytime you have to take a player off the floor like Rose, it's tough. ... But he can play in 3-guard lineups.”

Dwane Casey on Derrick Rose, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.
